name: math-typing-for-tldraw
description: Type maths on tldraw.com: symbols as you type, real fractions and roots, a calculator, graphs and shapes.

scripts.lint: node scripts/build.mjs firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.start:firefox: node scripts/build.mjs firefox && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox --start-url https://www.tldraw.com
